name: Multibase India Limited
about: Multibase India Limited manufactures, trades, and sells thermoplastic elastomers and silicone-based products in India and internationally. It offers polypropylene compounds, silicon and thermoplastic master batch, siloxane master batch, TPSiV multiflex SiE, multipro, and other related products. The company serves the automotive, portable electronics, building and construction, consumer, and industrial sectors. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Synergy Multibase Limited and changed its name to Multibase India Limited in August 2007. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Daman, India. Multibase India Limited is a subsidiary of Multibase SA.
